comparison.objective: Fit a compression-only diagonal brace so a sagging gate supports itself.
comparison.physical_skill: Structural diagnosis, brace placement, compression engagement, and release-under-load, not percussive insert finishing.
comparison.success_condition: Released gate remains square, scored by latch-side drop; exact score thresholds are only referenced in an unavailable README.
comparison.reason: Force-bearing placement and post-release stability are materially different from notch fracture and fragment retrieval.
